package langchain

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestZZGen(t *testing.T) {
	in := os.Getenv("LC_IN")
	if in == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	data, _ := os.ReadFile(in)
	var cases map[string]struct {
		Events    []interface{} `json:"events"`
		Opts      struct{ SendStart, SendFinish *bool } `json:"opts"`
		Callbacks bool          `json:"callbacks"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := map[string]interface{}{}
	for k, c := range cases {
		ch := make(chan interface{}, len(c.Events))
		for _, e := range c.Events {
			ch <- e
		}
		close(ch)
		cb := &StreamCallbacks{SendStart: c.Opts.SendStart, SendFinish: c.Opts.SendFinish}
		o, errs := ToUIMessageStreamFromAnyWithCallbacks(context.Background(), ch, cb)
		var chunks []interface{}
		for x := range o {
			chunks = append(chunks, x)
		}
		<-errs
		b, _ := json.Marshal(chunks)
		var norm interface{}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &norm)
		if norm == nil {
			norm = []interface{}{}
		}
		out[k] = norm
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	_ = os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("LC_OUT"), b, 0o644)
}
